question: What carried counts, replenish settings, cooldowns and effect rules (fuse times, flash and stun durations, repair rates, defibrillator ranges, supply values) do the gadget registries store?

sourceFacts.method: Every named value row of every saved GRX registry was listed with the file offset of its default. Rows were selected by name from Common/Hardware/Gadgets/GRX_Gadgets_Glacier and GRX_Gadgets_Glacier_CH1_S02: the ammunition, replenish and recharge rows of each gadget owner, and the flat rule rows for grenades, flash and stun effects, repair, defibrillator, supply and call-in gadgets. Each default was read back from the raw file at its offset. Rows are registry defaults; own asset values are in L3307.

control.description: First six selected rows, read back at their stored offsets.

inference: Row names are the registry's own; what each controls is read from the name only.
Flashbang, M320 flash and stun drill rows hold identical numbers, which suggests one shared effect rule.
EA's stated defibrillator timing (0.35 s minimum, 1 s full) is close to but not equal to the stored 0.3 and 1.0; the difference is unexplained.
unresolved: Whether a match uses these defaults or the gadget assets' own values where they differ. Test: count carried items of a gadget on spawn and compare with the stored NumberOfMagazines and MagazineCapacity.
What AutoReplenishDelay and AutoReplenishRounds -1 mean. Test: use all of a self-replenishing gadget away from any supply source and time the return of each item.
Flash duration by angle and range. Test: have a teammate throw a flashbang at 5 m and 10 m while facing it, side-on and facing away, and time the white-out (stored 3.5 / 2.5, 1.5 / 1.0, 0.6 / 0.2).
Repair rate units. Test: time a repair of a tank from a known health to full with the repair tool (stored 40 per second, 60 active).
Grenade fuse. Test: time a frag from release to detonation with and without a bounce (stored 1.1 minimum, 1.4 after a bounce).
Rows whose default is boxed or unreadable are listed in the dataset as not offset-checked and carry no value.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Gadget counts, replenish, cooldown and effect rules in the gadget registry
leads.summary: 517 gadget registry rows store carried counts, replenish settings, recharge times and effect rules: grenade fuse 1.1 and 1.4 after a bounce, flash durations 3.5 down to 0.2 by angle and range, repair 40 per second, defibrillator charge 0.3 to 1.0, vehicle supply crate 15 supplies every 5. 517 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: An in-game count, timing or duration measurement for one of these gadgets, or a game update that changes a row.
leads.statusNote: Registry defaults only; meaning from row names; units and runtime use unconfirmed.

assets.question: What carried counts, replenish settings, cooldowns and effect rules (fuse times, flash and stun durations, repair rates, defibrillator ranges, supply values) do the gadget registries store?
assets.conclusion: Fuse rows: frag and default grenade 1.1 minimum and 1.4 after a bounce; concussion 0.7 and 0.4. Flashbang, M320 flash and stun drill share duration rows 3.5 / 2.5 in front, 1.5 / 1.0 to the sides, 0.6 / 0.2 behind at close / far, close range 6, max range 12. Repair tool 40 per second (60 active), anti-repair 30 (45 active), range 2, interval 0.1. Defibrillator charge 0.3 minimum and 1.0 full, range 2 friendly and 1.5 enemy. Vehicle supply crate 15 supplies, interval 5. Supply pouch regeneration 25 for 4.
